name: MSME payment due date
blurb: Last date to pay a micro or small supplier
intro: If you buy from a micro or small enterprise, there is a time limit to pay. Find the last date.

steps.title: Pick the date of acceptance
steps.body: The date you accepted the goods or services.

steps.title: Say if there is a written agreement
steps.body: If yes, enter the days agreed in writing.

formula: Last date = date of acceptance + the days allowed by the rule above.
